topic.title: Second 47 Disclosure
topic.claim: Every 'get ready with me' reel buries the paid partnership tag around the 47th second, right after the hook and the outfit reveal.
topic.behaviour: Creators flash 'ad' in small text after they've already got you watching, just before the link in bio.
topic.mechanism: The disclosure exists to satisfy the platform's rule, not to actually tell you upfront what you're watching.
topic.why_now: this pattern has basically become the default across creator ads

score.why: Named, funny, deflates influencer marketing exactly the way she already believes nobody's really measuring the pitch.

topic.title: Instagram is testing a homescreen with no photos on it
topic.claim: Instagram quietly testing a homescreen that opens straight into Reels instead of photos is the company finally admitting what it already knows about what you actually watch.
topic.behaviour: Meta is piloting a redesigned Instagram in India and South Korea where users land directly on a Reels feed, with a new bottom bar ordering Home, Reels, Stories, DMs and Profile, and three feed tabs called All, Friends and Latest.
topic.mechanism: India has the biggest short-video audience Instagram has anywhere, built on the back of the 2020 TikTok ban, and app design always follows where the attention already is, not where the company wants it to be.
topic.group: Instagram users and creators who still post photo carousels
real_details: Test markets are India and South Korea
New bottom bar order: Home, Reels, Stories, DMs, Profile
Three feed tabs: All, Friends, Latest
topic.news_peg: TechCrunch report on Meta's Reels-first homescreen test, October 6, 2026
topic.why_now: The test just leaked and is being discussed by creators this month

score.why: A named platform quietly admitting what it already knows about its own users, sharp and plain, no sociology detour.

topic.title: Property is the new rishta
topic.claim: Single women are now buying homes purely as investment, not waiting for a husband's income or sanction, and I think homeownership just stopped being proof you got married and became proof you didn't have to wait.
topic.behaviour: Women now make up close to a third of India's homebuyer base, nearly a third of women buyers purchasing purely as an investment rather than for marriage or family use, most states now offering stamp-duty discounts for property registered in a woman's name, trend strongest in Bengaluru, Pune and Hyderabad.
topic.mechanism: Delayed marriage and rising incomes mean the biggest financial decision of a young woman's life no longer needs a man's name on it or a family's sanction.
topic.group: single, career-established women in their late 20s to 40s in metro cities
real_details: women make up close to a third of India's homebuyer base in 2026
nearly a third of women buyers are purchasing purely as an investment rather than for marriage or family use
most states now offer stamp-duty discounts for property registered in a woman's name
trend is strongest in Bengaluru, Pune and Hyderabad
topic.news_peg: 2026 industry homebuyer data on single women homebuyers, reported October 2026
topic.why_now: multiple 2026 datasets on this converged and were reported this month

score.why: Property and authority shifting to whoever owns it is her territory; this just puts a 2026 name on it without repeating the arranged-marriage angle.
